title: Prompts that start the same way share a path
notes: A caches all 6 of its tokens. B shares "the cat sat on the" with it, so the edge splits after 5 tokens and only rug is prefilled. C shares "the cat": the edge splits again, and 4 tokens are prefilled. In all 7 of 18 prompt tokens came from the cache (39%).
